## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest -q` passes locally
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes locally
- [ ] Added / updated tests for the change (offline — no live network, no real key)
- [ ] Updated `README.md` / docs if behavior or usage changed
- [ ] Added a `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `## [Unreleased]`
- [ ] No secrets committed (private key, API keys, seeds)
